main_text.p: tus fuliginosis liquidis & ferofis ultimæ concoctionis excrementis exitum præ-bentes. Ex hisce poris erumpunt etiam pili, qui ex viscidis recrementis, & vaporibus glutinosis ac fuliginosis calore ex-pulsis, ad corporis commodum ena-scuntur.
Cutis partes sunt δέρμα καὶ ἐπιδερμίς.
Δέρμα.Δέρμα est vera cutis interior, crassa, sensus exquisitissimi, ex nervorum filamentis, venis & arteriis conflata.
Estque organum tactus propter nervos, extremitates suas ad hanc transmit-tentes.
ἐπιδερ-μὶς.Ἐπιδερμὶς seu cuticula est pars superfi-ciaria exiccata & tenuis medium tactus.

Cuti subest plerunq; adeps, quæ suavis & mitis caloris ope, e sanguinis portione tenui, aerea & pingui per mufcu-lofam carnem transeunte, tandemque membranis illidente, & earum frigiditate (alii, soliditate:) concrescente, nasci-tur.Adeps,
Membrana carnosa.Membrana carnosa est universale involvens membrum, post cutem universum ambiens corpus.

page.notes: The Greek words in the margin and text (δέρμα, ἐπιδερμίς) are printed in Greek letters; the accents on ἐπιδερμίς are doubtful: [?] not added as the forms are legible. The text word "ferofis" is printed with a long s and read as "serosis" in the printing; it is transcribed as printed. The faint mark in the lower left margin (near the foot of the text) is not a clear signature and is omitted. A small mark at the top right of the page is not printed text and is omitted. The bottom line "caro," is the catchword.
